name: Altoviz for WooCommerce
author: Altoviz

sections.description:
Altoviz for WooCommerce will automate your invoicing process with a complete feature set :

  • Update the Altoviz products from the WooCommerce products
  • Update the Altoviz customers from the WooCommerce customers
  • Create invoices from orders
  • Send invoices to customers
  • Create credits from refunds
  • Direct link to Altoviz products, customers, invoices and credits
  • Logs synchronization activities
  • Customize behaviour through settings
    • Create invoice on order completion
    • Create draft or finalized invoices
    • Automatically send invoices
    • Log level

Requirements

  1. WooCommerce
  2. An active Altoviz subscription

Limitations

  1. Only works with the Altoviz app
  2. Euro (EUR) is the only supported currency
  3. French is the only supported language
sections.installation:
• Automated Installation

Installation is free, quick, and easy. Set up Altoviz for WooCommerce in minutes.

  1. Goto your WordPress website dashboard plugin page
  2. Search for Altoviz
  3. Click on Install
  4. Click on Activate
  5. Goto WooCommerce Settings
  6. Connect your Altoviz account
  • Manual Alternatives

Alternatively, install Altoviz for WooCommerce via the plugin directory, or upload the files manually to your server and follow the on-screen instructions.

  1. Upload the plugin archive content to the “/wp-content/plugins/altoviz” directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress
sections.faq:
What currencies are supported ?

Only Euro (EUR) is actually supported.

What languages are supported ?

French is the only language supported.

Is this plugin free ?

Yes, free to use.

What Altoviz edition is required ?

All Altoviz editions, including Altoviz Free, can be used.

What WooCommerce plugins are supported ?

  • WooCommerce Subscriptions
  • EU VAT Number for WooCommerce
